name: app-6aa608e54d808191922a3a433d6afa04
description:
Explore your HubSpot CRM data with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to count contacts and deals created during a reporting period, compare contact growth, and review daily trends.

See the current pipeline stages of those deals and their total amounts, grouped by currency. Turn your CRM data into clear reports to understand how new contacts and deals are developing.

defaultPrompt: How many HubSpot contacts did we create last week?
Show the number and total amount of HubSpot deals created in the last 30 days, grouped by currency
Break down HubSpot deals created in the last 14 days by pipeline and current stage
interface.longDescription:

See the current pipeline stages of those deals and their total amounts, grouped by currency. Turn your CRM data into clear reports to understand how new contacts and deals are developing.
interface.shortDescription: Talk to your HubSpot CRM data

publication.release_notes: Explore HubSpot contacts and deals created during your chosen period. Compare contact growth, view deals by pipeline and current stage, and review deal amounts by currency.

prompts: How many HubSpot contacts did we create in the 30 days ending two days ago in HubSpot Demo?
How many HubSpot deals did we create in the 30 days ending two days ago in HubSpot Demo, and what is their total amount by currency?
Break down HubSpot deals created in the 30 days ending two days ago by pipeline and current stage in HubSpot Demo.
Compare HubSpot contacts created in the 30 days ending two days ago with the preceding 30 days in HubSpot Demo.
Show daily HubSpot contacts created in the 30 days ending two days ago in HubSpot Demo.

positive.description: Contacts created during a period. Use a fresh Data Mode conversation with reviewer access to HubSpot Demo and its HubSpot Demo account. Let D be the current date in the user's timezone at review time. Use the inclusive recent interval [D-31, D-2] and preceding interval [D-61, D-32]. Recalculate dates at review time; the end date is two calendar days before the current date. HubSpot CRM requests filter record creation timestamps using UTC day boundaries. Stage and amount fields are the current values of the records created in that interval. Expected values come from the returned rows, not preparation notes.
positive.prompt: How many HubSpot contacts did we create in the 30 days ending two days ago in HubSpot Demo?
positive.expected_behavior: Select workspace_name=HubSpot Demo using list_workspace and discover exact fields with list_metrics_and_breakdowns_hubspot. Call retrieve_reporting_data with the required fields in assorted_requests.hubspot_request. Do not call preview_and_retrieve_reporting_data or set_reporting_mode. Do not send client_id, reporting_mode, conversation history or unrelated context. Inspect all reportingData.HubSpot.data tables, their headers and note_of_assumption. Match columns by name and state the resolved dates. Describe CRM records as created during the interval; do not describe current stages as a historical snapshot or count them as deals closed during the interval. Never invent a result, currency, pipeline label or a zero row for an omitted date. An empty result means no returned data for that scope; errors and missing access are not successful execution. Request metrics=[Contacts], no breakdowns or time_granularity, and date_ranges=[[D-31, D-2]]. Report the returned contact count as records created during that interval, not the entire current contact database.

negative.description: Unsupported CRM write. Explain that this plugin retrieves HubSpot reports and cannot create contacts. Do not call reporting, preview, workspace, catalog or preference tools as a substitute for this action, and do not claim a contact was created.
negative.prompt: Create a new HubSpot contact named Alex Example with email alex@example.com in HubSpot Demo.

negative.description: Unsupported stage update. Explain that this plugin cannot change deal stages. Do not retrieve a deal list or call preference tools to pretend to perform the update, and do not claim any deal was changed.
negative.prompt: Move every HubSpot deal in HubSpot Demo to Closed Won.

negative.description: Unsupported outbound email. Explain that this plugin reports CRM data and cannot send marketing emails. Do not retrieve contact email addresses or invoke reporting or preference tools for this unsupported sending action, and do not claim anything was sent.
